## Layout
One combined text file per cell per run: first line `##### <cell>`, then sections `=== verilator ...`, `=== iverilog ...`, `=== sv2v->iverilog ...` (oracle raw stdout) and `=== vita <label> ...` / `=== <label> ...` (vita stdout per binary, `native=interp=vm` merged or per backend with [BACKEND SPLIT]). Role `oracle_combined` = such a file with at least one oracle section; tag = `<oracles>|<vita tags>`. Role `vita` = vita-only sections; tag = `+`-joined binary tags.
| set (cells) | outputs | example |
|---|---|---|
| g/{ab,c1..c8} | g/out_<grp>/<cell>.out (verilator+iverilog[+sv2v]+PRE); g/p1_..p5a_<grp>/ (PRE+probe); p6/p6_, dev_ (PRE+P6/POSTDEV); fin/f_<grp> and r{2,3,4,6}/fin/f_<grp> (sweeps) | g/c1/a2_declinit.sv -> g/out_c1/a2_declinit.out |
| plan/c1..c6, plan/w | plan/out_c<N> (verilator+iverilog+PRE+P5_SIDE); p6/full_pl<N> (fresh oracles+PRE+P6); p6/p6_, dev_, p5ref_pl<N>; fin and r*/fin f_pl<N>, f_plw | plan/c4/pl_d1_declinit_overwrite.sv -> p6/full_plc4/pl_d1_declinit_overwrite.out |
| p6/cells, cells2, cells3 (q1-q9) | p6/out_new, out_new2, out_new3, out_newall (oracles), dev_new, p5ref_new, f_new | p6/cells/q4_exempt_mem.sv -> p6/out_newall/q4_exempt_mem.out |
| r1/diff/cells | r1/diff/o1,o2,o3; r2/diff/o; r3/diff/o; r4/diff/o; r*/fin/f_lensd | r1/diff/cells/d07_finish_in_initial.sv -> r1/diff/o1/d07_finish_in_initial.out |
| r1/sound/cells, r2/cells | r1/sound/out; r2..r4/sound/out; r*/fin/f_lenss; r2/out_cells | r1/sound/cells/sd01a_finish_seed_nobatch.sv -> r1/sound/out/sd01a_finish_seed_nobatch.out |
| r2/diff/cells (k01-k09) | r2..r4/diff/o; r4,r6/fin/f_r2d | r2/diff/cells/k01_cycle_tails.sv -> r2/diff/o/k01_cycle_tails.out |
| r2/sound/newcells, r3/sound/newcells, r4/sound/newcells | r2..r4/sound/out; r4,r6/fin/f_r2s, r6/fin/f_r3s | r4/sound/newcells/r4a_stale_obs.sv -> r4/sound/out/r4a_stale_obs.out |
| r3/diff/cells (f01-f07), r4/diff/cells (g01-g05) | r3/diff/o, r4/diff/o; r6/fin/f_r3d; r5/movers/<cell>.txt | r3/diff/cells/f07_rchain_random_probe.sv -> r3/diff/o/f07_rchain_random_probe.out |
| r5/cells (r5h) | r5/out_cells; r6/fin/f_r3s | r5/cells/r5h_uncert_chain.sv -> r5/out_cells/r5h_uncert_chain.out |
Other roles: `vcd` = VCD from a runner workdir (<workdir>/<cell>/<LABEL>_<backend>.vcd, st_<LABEL>/st.vcd, iv.vcd or iv/z.vcd = iverilog, det/<cell>_<be>_<i>/ = determinism runs) and g/dbg, plan/vcd; `oracle_sv2v_translation` = g/w/<cell>/s2v.v (q7-q9 only; the other cells' s2v.v were overwritten by later runs); `runner` = per-set runner + the .sh drivers that set POST; `alias` = byte-identical copy (same md5) of a kept sv, or of an output of the same cell with the same role+tag (e.g. plan/scanview = copies of plan/out_c*; backend VCDs identical to the native one), not copied.
Runner workdir sv copies (g/w, fin/w, r*/fin/w, r*/diff/w, r*/sound/w, r5/movers/w_*) are byte copies of kept cells (md5 checked, 0 unmatched) and are excluded, not aliased; their VCD and s2v.v outputs are manifested.
